PRECONDITIONS: MISSION_FENCE_STATE exists and is authoritative for the TARGET_AUTHORITY_KEY.
The old shard universe hash/version and proposed new shard universe hash/version are fully materialized and independently reproducible.
An immutable SHARD_UNIVERSE_UPDATE intent exists before entry CAS.

ENTRY_CAS.PRECONDITION: STATE_VERSION == EXPECTED_STATE_VERSION and all PRECONDITIONS still hold
ENTRY_CAS.AUTHORITY_EFFECT: All pre-entry leases and active memberships become stale for mutation authority before migration begins.

OLD_UNIVERSE_FREEZE: After successful entry CAS, no normal old-universe writer may obtain or renew mutation authority.
Old-universe namespaces remain readable as migration source and forensic truth.
Any write that physically appears from stale local state after entry is noncanonical stale evidence and must never enter the destination manifest as an authorized post-freeze record.
MIGRATION_RULES: Build the destination in inactive staging namespaces/refs; routing to the new universe remains non-authoritative before cutover.
Migrate each canonical record exactly once by immutable record identity, not by path identity alone.
Preserve record generation/version, content hash, provenance and terminal/nonterminal status semantics.
If multiple old physical rows map to one immutable record ID, require deterministic reconciliation evidence; unresolved conflict blocks migration.
Every old-universe shard in every migrated domain must produce a source manifest, including explicit empty shards.
Every new-universe shard in every migrated domain must produce a destination manifest, including explicit empty shards.
For every migrated domain, source and destination record-ID multisets must be identical after canonical reconciliation; count-only equality is insufficient.
No destination record may exist without source provenance or an explicitly authorized migration-metadata record outside the migrated user/control record set.

MIGRATION_VERIFICATION.FAILURE: Any mismatch sets ACTIVE_TRANSITION_STATE = MIGRATION_BLOCKED and keeps every gate CLOSED. No cutover is permitted.

PRECONDITIONS: all migration proof roots are bound to ACTIVE_TRANSITION_INTENT_HASH
CUTOVER_CAS.LINEARIZATION_POINT: The successful expected-version Mission Fence CAS that installs the new shard universe. Before it U1 is authoritative; after it U2 is authoritative while all normal gates remain closed.

POST_CUTOVER_VERIFICATION: Re-read Mission Fence and prove the installed hash/version equal the immutable intent.
Recompute destination domain/shard manifests from the now-authoritative universe.
Prove the destination roots still match the pre-cutover verified migration roots.
Prove old-universe namespaces are marked historical/read-only and no router grants active authority against them.
Require all active Chats to renew/rebind membership under the incremented MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH before normal mutation can resume.

ATOMIC_WRITES: ACTIVE_TRANSITION_ID = null only after durable transition result preserves the completed transition identity
ACTIVE_TRANSITION_INTENT_HASH = null only after durable transition result preserves the completed intent hash
WORK_ADMISSION_GATE = OPEN when otherwise permitted by mission state
MUTATION_GATE = OPEN when otherwise permitted by mission state
INTEGRATION_GATE = OPEN when otherwise permitted by mission state
FINALIZATION_CAS.NOTE: Gate reopening is conditional on every other mission/health prerequisite; this protocol does not override unrelated blockers.

CRASH_RECOVERY: Before entry CAS: no transition authority exists; abandoned staging artifacts are noncanonical.
After entry CAS but before verified migration: recover from immutable intent and source manifests with gates CLOSED; never restart normal writers.
After migration verification but before cutover CAS: U1 remains authoritative; destination remains staging only.
After cutover CAS: U2 is authoritative but gates remain CLOSED until post-cutover verification and membership renewal readiness are proven.
If actual fence state, routing state or destination manifests are ambiguous after a crash, set/retain a reconciliation-required transition state and keep all gates CLOSED.
Never erase U1/U2 evidence or choose a universe by blind force.
CLOSURE_INTERLOCK: Global closure entry is forbidden while TRANSITION_KIND == SHARD_UNIVERSE_UPDATE.
Global closure is forbidden while any shard migration state is blocked, ambiguous, unverified or awaiting post-cutover verification.
The closure SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH must equal the verified post-cutover Mission Fence value, and every shard in that exact universe including empty shards must appear in the drain manifest.
